# Greenwich & Delancey

> OU Glatt kosher deli catering by Chef David Teyf of Madison and Park Hospitality Group. Hand-carved pastrami, pickled corned beef, matzah ball soup, babka and the full deli table, delivered and set up for simchas, offices, Shabbat, holidays and dinners at home across Greenwich and Fairfield County CT, Westchester County NY and Manhattan.

- Kosher supervision: OU Glatt kosher.
- Catering orders start at $360, including dinner for the family at home.
- No catering on Saturdays.
- Carving service can be provided on-site for larger gatherings.
- The deli is moving to a new location. Catering continues in the meantime.
- Catering inquiries: jenn@madisonandparkgroup.com, or the request form on the catering page.

- [Our Story](https://www.greenwichanddelancey.com/about): Chef David Teyf and the history of the deli.
- [Home](https://www.greenwichanddelancey.com/): an overview of catering, occasions and favorites.
